repos_data.description: MCP server for email deliverability testing across 9 providers. Test inbox placement (Inbox vs Spam vs Promotions) with SPF/DKIM/DMARC verification. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf.
The most complete MCP server for the Resend email API — full API coverage plus a unique debug/diagnostics layer.
Official MCP server for Giggal.ai: catch-all, accept-all, and SEG-protected email verification for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other MCP clients.

Coldrig — cold email infrastructure run entirely by your coding agent (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Cline). One token, 28 intent-level MCP + HTTP tools and an npm CLI: domain purchase, mailboxes, warmup, sequences, replies, deliverability guardrails. Free fault-injecting sandbox.
